description: Zuko's steady flame for vetting a performance number. A flame that flickers is not a measurement. Use for benchmark-checklist, /benchmark-checklist, before you report or act on a speedup, a regression, a latency, a throughput, a hillclimb harness, or a library or config choice you measured. Checks the limiter, tuning, physical limits, errors, repeatability, relevance, and whether the work happened at all.
